league.definition:
n. an association of sports teams that organizes matches for its members
n. an association of states or organizations or individuals for common action
n. an obsolete unit of distance of variable length (usually 3 miles)
v. unite to form a league
league.translation:
n. 同盟, 联盟, 盟约
v. 组联盟, (使)加盟

league table.translation: n. 比赛成绩表, 比赛名次表

leagued.translation: v. 联盟( league的过去式和过去分词 ); 等级; （运动）俱乐部的联合会; 里格（长度单位, 约等于 3 英里）

leaguer.definition:
n. The camp of a besieging army; a camp in general.
n. A siege or beleaguering.
v. t. To besiege; to beleaguer.
leaguer.translation:
n. 围攻, 盟员
vt. 围攻

leaguerer.translation:
[古语]
n. 周围；包围；围攻；围城；围攻期间；围攻部队
vt. 围困；围攻

leaguers.definition:
plural of leaguer
n. The camp of a besieging army; a camp in general.
n. A siege or beleaguering.
v. t. To besiege; to beleaguer.
leaguers.translation:
(leaguer 的复数) n. 围攻, 盟员
vt. 围攻

leagues.definition:
n an association of sports teams that organizes matches for its members
n an association of states or organizations or individuals for common action
n an obsolete unit of distance of variable length (usually 3 miles)
v unite to form a league
leagues.translation:
n. 联盟( league的名词复数 ); 等级; （运动）俱乐部的联合会; 里格（长度单位, 约等于 3 英里）
v. 联盟( league的第三人称单数 ); 等级; （运动）俱乐部的联合会; 里格（长度单位, 约等于 3 英里）

leaguing.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of League
leaguing.translation: v. 联盟( league的现在分词 ); 等级; （运动）俱乐部的联合会; 里格（长度单位, 约等于 3 英里）
